caption: sky note: "mercury in aquarius makes everyone emotionally unavailable." half true at best. mercury enters aquarius today.

slides.headline: “*mercury* in aquarius makes everyone emotionally unavailable”
slides.dek: mercury enters aquarius today. here's the honest version

slides.headline: “from today, nobody will text you back with feelings”
slides.body: astrologers do read mercury in aquarius as cooler, idea-first talk. but that's a style, not a shutdown. people who answer warmly keep doing it, and the ones who never did weren't waiting on mercury.

slides.headline: mercury never strays *far* from the sun
slides.body: from earth, mercury always sits within about 28° of the sun, so it's in the sun's sign or a neighbour. today it's in aquarius while the sun is still in capricorn.

slides.headline: clear head, *honest* words
slides.body: astrologers read this as good weather for saying what you think plainly. feelings still count. you just name them instead of hinting.

slides.headline: unavailable is a person, *not a planet*.
slides.body: the honest take: the first thing you say should be true, not cute. that works in every sign.
